130:t_004:17.en:
$$ノイン$$
「We can't indulge that man's personal hobby.」

130:t_004:18.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We have little time...! We'll wipe out the enemy swiftly!」

130:t_004:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll do it... for Japan, for everyone at $$陣代高校$$...」

130:t_004:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「And for $$シンジ$$ and the others who aren't here, too!!」

130:t_005:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've confirmed that all enemy units have been destroyed.」

130:t_005:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「So Japan is safe now.」

130:t_005:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The troops sent to Japan this time seem to fall under a different command from those attacking $$新日本$$.」

130:t_005:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Now that we've defeated their commander, $$ダバラーン$$, a second wave probably won't come right away.」

130:t_005:5.en:
$n
「...Captain $$オットー$$, I have a proposal.」

130:t_005:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「There's no need, $n. I know what you're about to say.」

130:t_005:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And I'm sure we all want the same thing.」

130:t_005:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, return to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ at once. We're heading for $$新日本$$!」

130:t_005:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll show those goddamn bastards in the Empire the pride and determination of Earthlings!」

130:t_005:14.en:
$n
(And I believe... that someday I'll see you all again...)

130:t_006:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's good...! That's very good, $c!」

130:t_006:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now I have the pleasure of crushing you to look forward to! I thank heaven for coming to this planet and joining $$サイデリアル$$!」

130:t_006:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We have no intention of ever seeing you again!」

130:t_006:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Very well! I'll admit defeat here and withdraw from Japan for the time being!」

130:t_006:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But this isn't the end! I eagerly await the day we meet again on the battlefield!」

130:t_007:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$ and the $$ハイアデス$$... They're unusual even among $$サイデリアル$$.」

130:t_008:0.en:
$$カレン$$
($$シンジ$$... You aren't here anymore, but...)

130:t_008:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(I swear...! Just as you fought for the world and those you cared about, I'll keep fighting too...!)

130:t_008:2.en:
$$カレン$$
(Until peace returns to this lovable world...!)

130:t_100:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This ship... Its mobility and maneuverability are unlike any battleship we know...!」

130:t_100:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「It's only natural that you feel that way. This $$アルデバル$$ is the limb of the $$ハイアデス$$ who race across the galaxy!」

130:t_100:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「The legend of the invincible $$ハイアデス$$ goes hand in hand with this $$アルデバル$$! However skilled a soldier you are, defeat is certain!」

130:t_100:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We have no time for that self-indulgence...! We're not fighting for fun!」

130:t_101:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's a battleship...! If I get right in close...!」

130:t_101:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You're naive...! Don't think you can take on this $$アルデバル$$ with such obvious tactics!」

130:t_101:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This bastard...! He really is the type who enjoys fighting!」

130:t_101:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let your blood boil hotter! Put your life on the line! Challenge me with your whole body and soul!」

130:t_101:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's the respect due when fighting the $$ハイアデス$$!!」

130:t_102:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's a fine machine...! But whether it lives up to its potential depends on its pilot!」

130:t_102:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this battleship...?! It's like a giant mobile armor!」

130:t_102:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So you've felt our $$アルデバル$$'s power firsthand. You have some skill.」

130:t_102:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But even if you've realized it, you're already too late! You'll be an offering to satisfy my fighting instincts!」

130:t_102:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This man... He's different from when we fought before...! Is this his true nature?!」

130:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think a mere Earth battleship can stand against this $$ハイアデス$$ $$アルデバル$$!」

130:t_103:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「He's going out of his way to provoke us on an open channel...!」

130:t_103:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「We aren't such spineless cowards that we'll keep quiet after being insulted this badly!」

130:t_103:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Everyone, you heard him! We'll meet him with this ship's full strength!」

130:t_103:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Show these invaders the determination of $$地球連邦軍$$ personnel!」

130:t_104:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Come, $$リアクター$$! I put my mission first last time, but today I'll fight you to my heart's content!」

130:t_104:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! His speed and tactics are on a completely different level from the battleships we know!」

130:t_104:2.en:
$n
「If textbook tactics don't work, I'll fight by instinct! That seems to be what he wants too!」

130:t_104:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's right! I don't need superficial combat tricks! Come at me with your fighting instincts themselves!」

130:t_104:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We joined $$サイデリアル$$ to fight battles like that!」

130:t_105:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「You understand why we came here, $$カレン$$...!」

130:t_105:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「We'll crush the $$サイデリアル$$ forces in front of us! That's the first thing to do!」

130:t_105:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you have a problem with that, $$スザク$$?」

130:t_105:3.en:
$$スザク$$
「No... That's fine. We won't let them take anything else from us!」

130:t_105:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's do this, $$カレン$$! We'll crush $$サイデリアル$$ completely!」

130:t_106:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm sorry, $$ノイン$$. I've dragged you along on another difficult mission.」

130:t_106:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I volunteered for it myself, $$ゼクス$$.」

130:t_106:2.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Besides, if you and I work together, nothing is difficult.」

130:t_106:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Your words give me the strength to fight...! Let's go together, $$ノイン$$!」

130:t_106:4.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I'm ready anytime... and I'll stay with you forever!」
